description: This is a test source file for the OfflineFirstNewsRepository in a Kotlin-based Android project. It contains unit tests verifying the functionality of the repository, including synchronization with network data, database updates, notification handling, and filtering logic.

classes.name: OfflineFirstNewsRepositoryTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of OfflineFirstNewsRepository, including synchronization, data consistency, filtering, and notification mechanisms.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test dependencies and configures the repository before each test.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_news_resources_stream_is_backed_by_news_resource_dao
methods.description: Verifies that the news resources stream from the repository is backed by the DAO.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_news_resources_for_topic_is_backed_by_news_resource_dao
methods.description: Checks that filtered news resources based on topics are correctly retrieved from DAO.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sync_pulls_from_network
methods.description: Tests that synchronization fetches data from network and updates local database accordingly.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sync_deletes_items_marked_deleted_on_network
methods.description: Ensures that items marked as deleted on the network are removed locally during sync.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_incremental_sync_pulls_from_network
methods.description: Validates that incremental sync fetches only the changed data after a specific version.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sync_saves_shell_topic_entities
methods.description: Checks that topic shell entities are saved correctly during sync.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sync_saves_topic_cross_references
methods.description: Verifies that topic cross-references are stored correctly during sync.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sync_marks_as_read_on_first_run
methods.description: Tests that news resources are marked as read upon the first successful synchronization.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sync_does_not_mark_as_read_on_subsequent_run
methods.description: Ensures that news resources are not marked as read after subsequent syncs.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_sends_notifications_for_newly_synced_news_that_is_followed
methods.description: Verifies that notifications are sent for new news resources related to followed topics.

methods.name: offlineFirstNewsRepository_does_not_send_notifications_for_existing_news_resources
methods.description: Checks that notifications are not duplicated for already existing news resources.
